High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready errata card for Collision!, a fan re-set (not a Players Committee or Decipher publication) with the Decipher errata text of [[Collision! (Decipher Errata 1998)]] and his own gold-ring “E” (Premiere Limited, Light Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Errata/Light_E/Collision _ E.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/1BKZCCN1pdzee4XXeoabbyrdrAaFuKEYb/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Collision _ E.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,341,236 bytes, SHA-256 <code>4531d2e50f69b51e3a77a4b8bfe7a8350a8ec4f5f1c0496a4bcdbe720f76bad9</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 46.0, 47.5, 74.0, 57.0 px); resized: no; no other change.

It is listed in the card's versions list as “strangewayes print (fan re-set)”; it is not shown on the Decipher Errata or Players Committee version pages.

Credit: image by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project.
